interpretation: Acceptance resolves only the eight self-contained authored spell procedures. A procedure-level design question now answered by an explicit new local rule is closed for this accepted text; the original source scenario remains held wherever actual source facts, physical profiles, support, occupants, credentials, routes, suppressors, or terrain are absent.

procedureQuestionsResolved: finite selected quantity and working region
one forced-displacement attempt per subject per family per round
buoyancy and airway are not invented
residualHolds: actual container walls and open route
actual swimmer immersion, current, breathing, occupied sweep and boat profile
clarifications.disposition: Procedure text supplies local rules; original scene vectors remain conditional.

procedureQuestionsResolved: four finite modes and uppermost one-foot surface layer
one captured-DC ice slip save per victim/ice family/regular cycle
residualHolds: ordinary ice durability and later melt behavior
clarifications.disposition: The inherited hold wording about density and slip is narrowed to missing source/scene values and physical support; authored local reference values and the new slip rule are accepted.

procedureQuestionsResolved: first collision stop and zero movement when floor blocks a downward vector
residualHolds: actual Large body profile and mass
actual STR result and final scene-specific stop
clarifications.disposition: Q09 is resolved as authored procedure text. The inherited request to resolve center, collision order, and ground blocking is superseded for procedure review; the original case remains held for its missing creature and physical facts.

procedureQuestionsResolved: single revalidation at specified real trigger points
no recovery of expelled occupants or restored damage
residualHolds: actual wall, mouths and receiving space
actual suppressor spell, scope, and timing
clarifications.disposition: Q11 is resolved as authored procedure text. The original case remains conditional for missing physical fixtures and a real suppressor; raw hold text is preserved as historical evidence.

residualHolds: actual source material and occupied geometry
